name: Greed-with-uncrowded-funding trend join (momentum-regime composite)
rationale: A deliberately INVERTED composite to test the niche from the other side: sentiment and positioning must agree on RISK-ON, but only when positioning is not yet stretched. Arm a long when Fear&Greed is in the GREED band (crowd is optimistic, trend regime) AND funding is still BELOW a moderate ceiling (the leveraged crowd has NOT fully piled in — there is fuel left). The thesis: early-greed with uncrowded funding is a healthy uptrend to join; late-greed with hot funding is a blow-off top to avoid. This is the same two ingredients as the capitulation specs but composed for continuation, giving the Gate a genuinely distinct hypothesis to dispose. Funding remains a crowding filter (null carry); ceiling straddles realized levels so the 'uncrowded' condition actually excludes hot bars. DISCONFIRMER: a greed-only trend-join sibling is in this cohort — if dropping the funding ceiling does not reduce the deflated/holdout Sharpe, the uncrowded gate is decorative and this is naive top-chasing that the Gate should FAIL. If the funding ceiling has to sit near the +1e-4 cap to trade at all, it is not filtering and the result is suspect. Honest FAIL accepted.
catalyst: greed sentiment with funding still below a moderate (uncrowded) ceiling
